punchline: Susan Jeffers says most decisions aren't right-or-wrong; both paths can be wins.
thirty_sec: In Feel the Fear and Do It Anyway, Susan Jeffers contrasts the No-Win model, where one option is right and the other wrong, with the No-Lose model, where each path offers chances to learn and grow. Do your homework, choose, then let go of your fixed picture of the outcome and correct course if needed. Decisions become far less frightening.
question: Which decision are you stuck on right now?
